question: Do 90 further contrasting flight demonstrations lift not-found to the minimum without costing documents or chat, on development wording no unit has seen?
why: L6 met every minimum on generated-development except not-found (10/12): both misses ask whether the files have "anything about flying back from X" and L6 answers with the outbound itinerary. L7 is L6 plus 60 more return-flight not-found demonstrations and 30 more outbound flight-time demonstrations, on fresh workspaces and on the training templates generated-train used least. Because L6's development misses were read to design L7, L7 is judged on generated-development2: templates generated after L6, in a third style, none equal to any committed template.

unit.name: L7
unit.layers: A2 layers and projections, rank and alpha

experience.documents: the verified demonstrations of the 660 generated-train cases and the 90 generated-train-extra cases (60 not-found-return, 30 flight-time)
experience.replay: the parent's own greedy chat replies on the 320 generated-train chat cases (values quoted) under the chat2 policy, replayed only where they pass

training.rule: A2 trainer settings for the low-rank module; terminal step only; no checkpoint selection. Steps, mixture, replay and layers are L6's.

integration: parent and parent+L7 greedily on the 66 documents and 48 chat generated-development2 cases on the same GPU
next_gate: L7 advances to the sealed confirmation4 on the canonical CPU runtime only if, on generated-development2, it solves more documents cases than the parent, loses no more than one chat case, and every minimum (documents 85%, chat 90%, not-found 90%) holds.
development2_note: Only one refund-arithmetic template survived the 280-character limit in the background-first style, so development2's two refund cases share it with different values.
